summary: I pass on every market in this game. MIL is a clear favorite and I understand why: the home starter has an ERA of 1.8034 against 3.1 for the TB starter, and the books' own fair number for MIL is 0.6301. But that gap is already in the price, and the data cannot show me a mistake in it. The starters' stats only run through 2026-10-19, MIL has been off for 8 days with a long trip behind it, and the home bullpen section is empty, so I do not want to move off the market. The run line and the total look close to fair as well, with the over at 0.5075 by the books' number. On the player props, the prices are many hours old, only a few books quote them, and several sit at -200 or worse, which I will not take. Where LineHound's own model leans away from the books, the gap rests on little more than a season rate. What would change my mind is a late lineup or starter change, a fresher set of prop prices, or a clearly better number on MIL.

reasons.claim: The home starter has the far better season line, an ERA of 1.8034 against 3.1 for the visiting starter, which is why the books make MIL the clear favorite.
The books' own fair number for MIL is already 0.6301, so the starter edge looks priced in, and the stats only run through 2026-10-19.
MIL has not played in 8 days and is on a long eastward trip, which the data cannot translate into a number, and the home bullpen section is empty.

calls.what_would_change_it: A price on MIL better than -170, or news that either starter is scratched, would change this.
